messages.content: You write short test passages. Reply with the passage only: no title, no quotes, no commentary.
Write one or two sentences in which a source ("according to the filing", "the records say") reports this fact, and the passage presents it as true: Pidu Works participated in Nolu Accord Talks

response: According to the filing, Pidu Works participated in Nolu Accord Talks as an observer with a seat in the public gallery. The records say its representatives signed the attendance register on the first morning.
